sidebar.style: Collapsible with smooth transition, grouped section items, role badge at top, active pill indicator in Navy/Sky blue.

components: User Profile Dropdown with Avatar & Role

layout_architecture.page_container: p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-6 max-w-7xl mx-auto

key_modules.landing_page: Hero section with campus image, features overview, portal access CTA buttons, testimonials, fee structure sample, school contact.
key_modules.dashboard: Role-tailored stats cards, attendance overview chart, upcoming exams, recent announcements, quick actions.
key_modules.students_teachers_parents: Filterable/searchable datatables with pagination, status badges, CRUD modal forms, student detail drawer/view.
key_modules.attendance_grid: Daily/Weekly grid with P (Present), A (Absent), L (Late), HD (Half Day) quick toggle buttons and batch submit.
key_modules.timetable_grid: Weekly matrix (Monday-Saturday vs Time Slots) showing Class, Subject, Room, Teacher card blocks.
key_modules.exams_marks_reportcards: Marks entry grid per class/subject, printable PDF-style Report Card template with grade calculation & school header.
key_modules.fees_invoices_receipts: Fee status cards, online payment trigger, printable fee receipt modal with INR breakdown and official seal design.
key_modules.homework_submissions: Homework posting, file attachment indicator, student submission status table with grading input.
key_modules.library_transport_leave: Book availability catalogue, bus route tracker details, leave application & approval workflow.
key_modules.audit_logs_settings: System activity logs, role permission matrices, general school info configuration.

component_styling_rules.buttons: Pill or rounded-lg with focus rings. Primary buttons in Deep Navy or Sky Blue with subtle hover lift and Gold accent highlights.
component_styling_rules.cards: Bordered rounded-xl shadow-sm bg-card transition-all hover:shadow-md hover:border-accent/40
component_styling_rules.tables: Clean responsive tables with sticky headers, alternate row shading, search/filter bars, and pagination.
component_styling_rules.badges: Rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold for status (Present: green, Absent: red, Pending: amber, Paid: emerald).
component_styling_rules.printables: Clean white printable wrapper with print:block print:p-0 print:shadow-none rules for Report Cards and Receipts.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive buttons, inputs, links, tabs, tables, and modals MUST include explicit `data-testid` attributes (kebab-case).
